qa_pairs.instruction: Which versions of the Delimited Text driver can be upgraded directly to version 4.0.0.3?
qa_pairs.output: For the Delimited Text driver, you can upgrade from any 3.x version directly to version 4.0.0.3. Upgrading a pre-3.x version of the Delimited Text driver directly to version 4.0.0.3 is not supported.

qa_pairs.instruction: What should I do if I want to upgrade a pre-3.x version of the Delimited Text driver to version 4.0.0.3?
qa_pairs.output: Upgrading a pre-3.x version of the Delimited Text driver directly to version 4.0.0.3 is not supported. You must first upgrade to a 3.x version of the Delimited Text driver before upgrading to version 4.0.0.3.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the supported upgrade paths for the Delimited Text driver version 4.0.0.3.
qa_pairs.output: The Delimited Text driver version 4.0.0.3 supports upgrades from any 3.x version of the driver. Direct upgrades from pre-3.x versions are not supported and require an intermediate upgrade to a 3.x version first.
